name: Frest Greelving's Mansion
title: Frest Greelving's Mansion
summary: Frest Greelving's haunted mansion (Festivus): apparitions, hanging apparitions, skeletons and an Ursuin rug, with Frest's chest upstairs and his dungeon below. In the kit the mansion is a 2 x 2 block of gothic buildings on a bare hilltop (z 80) - three- and four-storey wings, a seven-storey tower and a seven-storey black clock tower (top z 111.1) - with 26 m dead antler trees, cobwebbed deer-skull props, a glowing pumpkin and a fresh zombie head in a bucket; the hill falls 30-50 m on every side.
